'''Leatherback''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] by the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. He was the owner of [[Leatherback's]] [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] in [[Meirm City]].<ref name="LCaL" />
